faq.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faq.answer: Check-in is from 3:00 pm and check-out is before 11:00 am. For an early arrival or a late departure, please contact us: we will do our best according to availability.

faq.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.answer: Pets are welcome upon prior request, with a cleaning supplement of 30 €. Please let us know at the time of booking.

faq.question: Is household linen provided?
faq.answer: Yes, sheets, bath towels and tea towels are provided and refreshed each week for stays of more than 7 nights.

faq.question: Is there parking on site?
faq.answer: Yes, private and secure parking is available to all our guests at no extra charge.

faq.question: How can I change or cancel my booking?
faq.answer: You may change or cancel your booking up to 14 days before arrival for a full refund. After that date, the stay remains due except in exceptional circumstances. Please contact us directly at contact@legabriel.fr.

faq.question: Is the gym included?
faq.answer: Access to the gym is complimentary for all residents. Outside visitors may also use it with a day pass at 15 €.

ouverture-appart-hotel-solenzara.title: Le Gabriel aparthotel opens in Solenzara
ouverture-appart-hotel-solenzara.excerpt: Discover a new way to stay: the privacy of an apartment with the services of a hotel, in the heart of Corsica.
content: It is with great pride that we open the doors of Le Gabriel, an aparthotel imagined as a contemporary guesthouse in the heart of Solenzara. Set between the fine sandy beaches of south-eastern Corsica and the mountains of the Alta Rocca, our establishment offers a new way to stay: the privacy and space of an apartment, together with the services you expect from a hotel.

Le Gabriel has 12 studios and 11 one-bedroom apartments, each welcoming 4 to 5 guests. Every home includes a fitted kitchen, fibre Wi-Fi, reversible air conditioning, a terrace or balcony, and a full set of household linen. The decoration, sober and elegant, draws on the tones of the Corsican earth to create a warm, soothing setting.

Beyond the apartments, we have designed welcoming shared spaces: a heated pool surrounded by a Mediterranean garden, private and secure parking, and a modern gym on the ground floor, open to residents and the public. Our team is on hand to arrange your arrival, advise you on the region and make every step of your stay straightforward.

Solenzara proves an ideal starting point from which to explore Corsica. Idyllic beaches, natural river pools, the Aiguilles de Bavella and the villages of the Alta Rocca are just minutes away. Whether you come to unwind, to hike or to discover the local gastronomy, Le Gabriel offers a refined pied-à-terre at the rhythm of the island.

guide-plages-solenzara.title: The finest beaches around Solenzara
guide-plages-solenzara.excerpt: From Canella to Santa Giulia, a tour of the sandy coves within easy reach of your aparthotel.
content: Solenzara is a little-known gem of the Corsican coastline, ideal for lovers of wild beaches and unspoilt coves. Just a few minutes by car or bicycle from Le Gabriel aparthotel, you will find stretches of fine sand edged by crystal-clear water.

Canella beach is perhaps the closest, and one of the most charming. Its golden sand, shaded by umbrella pines, is perfect for families. The warm, shallow water makes swimming safe, while the rocky seabed to the side invites snorkelling.

Further south, Favone beach surprises with an atmosphere that is both lively and natural. Small beach restaurants serve grilled fresh fish and Corsican specialities with your feet in the sand. For walkers, the coastal path alongside it opens onto spectacular views of the Aiguilles de Bavella.

Santa Giulia, further towards Porto-Vecchio, is also worth the excursion. Its turquoise lagoon is one of the most photographed in Corsica. And do not forget the natural pools of the Solenzara river: refreshing swims in the heart of the maquis, a short walk from the village. In summer, they become a favourite meeting place for locals and for our guests.

nouvelle-salle-sport.title: A modern gym on the ground floor
nouvelle-salle-sport.excerpt: Cardio, strength training and group classes: the new Le Gabriel gym welcomes residents and visitors.
content: Le Gabriel is more than quality accommodation: we have also thought about your physical well-being. Our gym, on the ground floor of the aparthotel, is open to both residents and the public. Available during the day and in the evening, it is equipped with modern machines that are regularly maintained.

The cardio area offers treadmills, elliptical trainers and rowers — ideal for unwinding after a day of hiking or at the beach. The free-weights area is equipped with dumbbells, benches and guided machines so you can work every muscle group safely.

We also run group classes led by certified coaches: outdoor yoga on the terrace in the morning, circuit training on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and a stretching session on Saturday afternoons. Residents enjoy complimentary access to the gym and preferential rates for classes.

Outside visitors can also use the space with a day pass at 15 € or a monthly membership at 39 €. Parking and changing rooms are available. Whether you are on holiday or live nearby, the gym at Le Gabriel welcomes you in an elegant, motivating setting, overlooking the Mediterranean garden.
